cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put you on wedding enquiries. You said you'd handle everyone who came to the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant opening it, not answering messages.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll type. You can tell them where to come; that's still getting them to the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know what to say about presents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send those to me. You handle directions; that's the part you already offered.

reason: Specify enquiries from guests and directions back to them; replace unsupported guest knowledge and half-door metaphor with a concrete narrowed handoff.
